evals.prompt: Create an Emailit webhook to https://api.acme.com/hooks/emailit for bounces and complaints.
evals.expected_output: Creates the webhook with email.bounced and email.complained and tells the user to store the secret as EMAILIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
expectations: Calls create-webhook with events email.bounced and email.complained
Tells the user to store the secret in an environment variable
Does not subscribe to all events

evals.prompt: Write an Express handler for Emailit webhooks.
evals.expected_output: Uses the raw body, verifies X-Emailit-Signature with HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.body, checks the timestamp, and loops over the event array.
expectations: Reads the raw body before JSON parsing
Signs timestamp + "." + raw body with HMAC-SHA256
Treats the body as an array of events

evals.prompt: My Emailit webhook was disabled. How do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Explains the 3 day failure rule, asks to fix the endpoint, and uses retry-failed-webhook-requests or update-webhook.
expectations: Explains that continuous failures disable the webhook
Suggests fixing the endpoint before retrying
